title: Illustrative engineering change record
author: Execution-package preview
why: Show the proposed one-page change record before adoption. A real first commit must establish a verified baseline rather than claim that repository cleanup has already succeeded.
what: Proposed bootstrap: a structured report, escaped LaTeX, compact PDF and minimal tool tests. This example is not a patch, repository commit or application validation.
how: Validate the staged payload first. Bind its evidence to a stable Report-ID, parent commit and candidate digest. Add the report triplet to that same commit; CI verifies independently.
preserved: No application source, public route, API, viewer behavior, deployment setting or organizational identity has been changed by this planning example.
risk: A report can look credible while describing unrun checks. Structural validation must be backed by actual execution and exact source-identity checks.
limitations: Current immutable HEAD, full workflows, application builds, browser behavior and deployment were not verified here. No repository commit or fork has been created.
rollback: Do not install this illustrative record as commit evidence. For a real change, revert its bounded payload in a new tested commit with its own new report.
